synopses.medium: SHERELLE pays tribute to the pioneering Dutch drum and bass producer Lenzman.
synopses.long:
SHERELLE pays tribute to the pioneering Dutch drum and bass producer Lenzman, who sadly passed away on 11 July 2026. One of her musical and production heroes, she takes a look back at his extensive discography - as well as the music that inspired him - over the course of this show. Exploring his releases on the esteemed Metalheadz, alongside output from Lenzman's own acclaimed label The North Quarter, SHERELLE reflects on the unmistakable soul encapsulated within Lenzman's music.

Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.

synopses.short: Gilles digs into his record collection to unearth the most obscure gems.
synopses.medium: Gilles digs into his massive record collection to find the most obscure gems for your listening pleasure. Plus, a tribute to Philadelphia's legendary musician, Dexter Wansel.
synopses.long:
Gilles digs into his massive record collection and picks out the rarest 45s, including a Thai song offering tips on how to win over your crush, a mysterious track from Barbados, and loads of joyful Brazilian bangers.
Elsewhere in the show, Gilles shares a new, special version of an interview from 2022 with the late iconic Philadelphia musician and arranger Dexter Wansel, who passed away last month. His forward-thinking approach to music, in particular with regard to the use of synthesisers in disco and funk, left an indelible mark and influenced generations of musicians. 

Produced by Reduced Listening for BBC Radio 6 Music
